definitions.gloss: resignation; giving up; acceptance of a situation
definitions.explanation: The act or state of accepting that something cannot be changed or achieved, often with a sense of acceptance.

examples.japanese: {諦|あきら}め⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{肝心|かんじん}→肝心：21541_kanjin⟧だ。
examples.english: Knowing when to give up is important.
A look of resignation appeared in his eyes.

examples.japanese: ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{諦|あきら}め⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つかない。
examples.english: I still can't bring myself to give up.
examples.notes: {諦|あきら}めがつく = to be able to accept/resign oneself

notes:
FORMS:
{諦|あきら}める (to give up) → {諦|あきら}め (noun form)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {諦|あきら}め⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく - to be able to give up/accept
- {諦|あきら}め⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つかない - unable to give up
- {諦|あきら}め⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ - unable to give up (negative trait)
- {諦|あきら}め⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧ - quick to give up
- {諦|あきら}め⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{肝心|かんじん}→肝心：21541_kanjin⟧ - knowing when to quit is important

PHILOSOPHICAL NOTE:
In Buddhism, {諦|あきら}め is related to the concept of acceptance of reality. The character {諦|あきら} can also mean 'truth' ({諦|たい}) in Buddhist terms.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{断念|だんねん}→断念：18938_dannen⟧ - abandonment (of a plan)
- ⟦{観念|かんねん}→観念：04125_kannen⟧ - resignation, acceptance
- ギブアップ - giving up (loanword)
